title: Reading Drill — Monitoring Moss on a Roof
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Monitoring Moss on a Roof
passages.body:
**A** A class followed the spread of moss on a roof model built on the ground. Each week students placed the same transparent grid over the surface to measure coverage.

**B** The moss first spread near the gutter, where the longest period of dampness had been recorded. The students could see that constant shade alone was not enough to predict coverage.

**C** After rainfall became less frequent, students continued taking pictures. They noticed that colour changed well before area, so their final report distinguished appearance from actual spread.
